title: Official Addons Mainline Contract Sentinels
problem: The addon repo depends on a moving private main Nako repo, but release gates and packaging still allow official addon catalog, CI, Docker, and publish automation drift.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-notification-bridge manifest routes --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened lane after inspecting main repo movement, local path SDK dependencies, metadata-only release gate smoke, and Dockerfiles that copy only the addon repository.
OAMC-020 moved notification bridge official manifest facts to nako-official-addon-catalog and passed notification manifest/routes tests.
OAMC-030 hardened release-gate and Docker build context contracts for all three official sidecars; local Docker build/smoke remains blocked by daemon availability.
OAMC-040 updated crates-publish and alpha.2 release-readiness docs to include notification bridge, metadata scraper, and Chromecast renderer.
OAMC-050 passed cargo metadata, fmt, workspace nextest, and diff hygiene; publish dry-runs remain blocked by upstream alpha.2 crates not yet published to crates.io.

continue_policy.notes: Lane is complete. Reopen or split a follow-on only after upstream alpha.2 SDK/catalog crates are published, Docker daemon evidence is available, or mainline Nako changes an addon-facing contract.
